title: ComponentMemberDirectory
description: Read-only member directory snapshot for an embedded component (.design/07 §4.7.4, DD-133(4)): every ACTIVE HUMAN member in the native page entry binding's scope with Kailo display name, avatar URL, Tenant role and ACTIVE Workspace memberships. A full snapshot, never paged: a person absent from it is removed from the component organisation. directoryVersion is the SHA-256 (hex) of the canonical JSON of every other field. No email, Buzz key, session or credential.

directoryVersion.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this snapshot without directoryVersion; unchanged content keeps the same version.

workspaces.description: Every ACTIVE Workspace in the binding scope (only the binding's own Workspace when it has one).

displayName.description: Kailo display name: the member's SERVER HUMAN kind:0 display_name (else name), else the HumanIdentity display name.

identities.description: One entry per ACTIVE external identity; the component keys its account on issuer + subject.

picture.description: <PUBLIC_ORIGIN>/api/v1/identity/avatars/<subject>, the same value as the IdP picture claim.
